reviewerOrPass: Worker B, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: Reconsidered the official programme, dated curriculum groups and actual course entry conditions before assessing the finished options against workbook course content and offered terms.
findings: The 180 EC route contains the 24 EC single-language sequence, 42 EC of second-year major and related choices plus 18 EC common work, and 18 EC third-year advanced and seminar work plus 30 EC free choice and the 12 EC thesis. The seminar and prior-credit checks are documented separately from optional UCR research.

The first plan offers substantial European integration and political economy through EU law and politics, world history and economic methods. The second uses European film traditions and comparative literary and historical methods. The third provides doctrinal law and institutional analysis with Criminal Law in its offered autumn after the gateway.

The positive pairings are partial. Film and Text shares methods with the European Culture workshop, while Life and Travel Writing complements the treatment of cultural boundaries. The advanced regional themes, formal language courses, two philosophy courses and the thesis remain separately visible.
